verdict.rationale: E2B documents running terminal commands in the sandbox via `commands.run()` and CLI exec, including background mode and an interactive terminal. It also describes a real Debian toolchain with full terminal access and outbound internet by default, and templates that can run setup commands, all of which support installing packages. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of package installation (e.g., pip/apt examples), independent hands-on corroboration of arbitrary command and package-install workflows.
